analysis.interpretation: A counterfactual, inference-excluded completion time for fixed work, not an actual end-to-end training wall-clock speedup.
analysis.method: Make inference stages instantaneous and bypass their resource pool, then resimulate the schedule. Do not subtract summed inference service or wait durations from wall time.
analysis.prior_results: The inference-included v1.0.0 release and data/reference/simulation remain unchanged.
analysis.profile_selection: The former long-model-call profile is omitted because it becomes identical to the short-compute profile once inference service and its queue are removed. All read conditions, fixed controls, and identity cases are retained.
analysis.question: Does adaptive image fetching reduce the execution time of equal agent-training work when model inference is excluded?

protocol.author: Majd Zayyad

execution.failures: Retain every failure/timeout. Do not simulate or score an incomplete or invalid calibration matrix.
execution.freeze: Record source, protocol, input and binary hashes before/after calibration; preserve every condition and do not retune from evaluation outcomes.
execution.scope: A parameterized execution-time experiment, not actual RL training or a production DSec evaluation.
execution.timing: One physical calibration arm at a time; cold per-process reader, deliberately warmed backing file.

protocol.primary_endpoint: Simulated wall time through the final learner update, with identical completed rollouts, model calls, verification and update work.
protocol.question: When does adaptive image fetching reduce the completion time of a fixed-work, synchronous agent-training simulation?
protocol.selection: Choose the fixed size minimizing equal-case/equal-repeat geometric process wall time on development only; numerical size breaks exact ties. Freeze before evaluation.

simulation.inference: Average schedule-seed log ratios within each calibration repeat, then form descriptive Student-t intervals across the three measured repeats. Schedule seeds are not additional physical measurements.
simulation.learner_rule: Each update waits for all 32 assigned rollouts; no next-update rollout starts until that update finishes. All arms complete 256 rollouts and 8 updates.
not_modeled: Actual policy learning or time to a quality target
Live LLM agents, rewards or task success distributions
Warm-cache lifecycle reuse or compression translation
An empirical distribution of production training workloads
simulation.pairing: Hold each measured repeat fixed across schedule seeds. The same work descriptors, jitter, task order, model/CPU/learner durations and resources are used for every policy.
simulation.reported_primary: Equal-weight geometric total-time ratios over all 27 evaluation conditions, separately for each training profile. Also report every condition, range, regressions, and the complete identity matrix.
simulation.resource_rule: Each tool worker represents an independently provisioned reader/backend budget with the calibration's resources. Separate workers do not secretly share one modeled bandwidth limit.
simulation.service_input: A measured total replay-process duration is the service time of one synthetic image-read tool job. It is not treated as pure storage latency or as an already-measured training speedup.
